full_prompt_en: A square studio photograph shows a theatrical adult figure seated cross-legged against a plain pale taupe background. The figure occupies most of the frame, forming a broad triangular mass of dusty-rose satin and dark lace. Voluminous gathered trousers balloon around the knees, while a patterned wrap and fitted upper garment carry black floral embroidery across the shoulders, arms, and torso. Dark lace gloves cover the hands; one hand rests under the chin in a thoughtful pose. A mauve head wrap frames the face and ties into a large bow at the back, topped by two sculptural rose ornaments. The face is painted chalk white with intricate black scrolling decoration around the eyes and cheek, heavy lashes, deep violet shadow, and dark plum lips. The gaze turns slightly upward and to the left rather than meeting the camera. Fabric folds remain visibly soft and weighty, with embroidery and lace adding fine surface detail against the larger pink planes. Gentle frontal studio light reveals the satin sheen and sculpted makeup without hard shadow edges; the background falls quietly away as a smooth neutral field. The restrained palette stays within blush pink, mauve, black, gray, and pale skin white. There are no props or scenery, so the unusual garment volumes and face ornament hold the entire composition. The image feels composed and introspective despite its extravagant design, balancing lush material detail with an uncluttered, subdued photographic setting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棚拍照片展示一位戏剧化成人物坐在素净浅灰褐背景前，双腿交叉。人物占据画幅大部分，形成由灰玫瑰色缎面和深色蕾丝组成的宽阔三角形体块。蓬起的褶皱裤装围住膝盖，带花纹的披裹与较贴身上衣在肩、臂和躯干上布满黑色花卉刺绣。双手戴深色蕾丝手套；一只手托着下巴，姿态沉思。淡紫头巾围住脸，后方系成大蝴蝶结，顶部有两朵雕塑般的玫瑰装饰。面部涂成粉笔白，眼周与脸颊有复杂黑色卷饰，浓睫毛、深紫眼影与暗梅红嘴唇突出。目光微微上抬并转向左侧，而不是直视镜头。布褶可见地柔软厚重，刺绣和蕾丝在大块粉色平面上增加细小表面细节。柔和的正面棚光显出缎面光泽和立体化妆，却没有硬阴影边；背景作为平滑中性色场安静退开。克制调色保持在浅粉、淡紫、黑、灰与浅白之间。没有道具或布景，因此奇特的服装体积与面部装饰承载全部构图。图像虽设计夸张却姿态内省，以丰盛材质细节平衡整洁柔暗的摄影环境。
style_prompt_en: Controlled studio photography sets extravagant fabric volume and intricate surface ornament against a quiet seamless neutral ground. Soft frontal illumination reveals satin sheen, lace transparency, embroidery, and sculpted matte surfaces without sharp cast shadows. Dusty rose and mauve occupy broad areas, while black patterned detail and pale white accents create concentrated contrast. A compact silhouette forms a stable triangular composition, with small folds and ornamental details supplying fine rhythms inside the large color mass. Edges remain photographically clear yet gently lit, and empty background space keeps the visual weight on material texture and designed form. The mood is theatrical but restrained, more contemplative than kinetic.
style_prompt_zh: 受控棚拍摄影把夸张布料体积和繁细表面装饰放在安静、无缝的中性背景前。柔和正面照明显出缎面光泽、蕾丝透感、刺绣和雕塑般哑光表面，没有锐利投影。灰玫瑰与淡紫占据宽阔面积，黑色纹样细节和浅白点缀制造集中对比。紧凑的形体轮廓形成稳定三角构图，细小褶皱与装饰细节在大色块内提供细密节奏。边缘保持摄影般清楚却受光柔和，空背景让视觉重量落在材质肌理和设计形体上。气氛戏剧化但克制，比起动势更偏沉思。
theme_en: A theatrical seated figure in rose-colored couture and ornate face paint
theme_zh: 身着玫瑰色高定服装、绘有繁复面妆的戏剧化坐姿人物
name: Leigh Bowery
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
